headline: Indonesian Police Detain Generals Over Alleged Presidential Wiretapping
summary: Indonesian police detained three senior police generals on suspicion of illegally wiretapping the phones of President Prabowo Subianto and other prominent figures between 2025 and 2026.
why: Indonesia is Southeast Asia's largest economy, and high-level political security investigations can influence investor perception of political stability and institutional governance.

impacts.name: Indonesia
impacts.why: Domestic political scandals can create uncertainty for local asset valuations.
